architecture.description:
The system has 4 interconnected brains: 1. Workflows (Conductor/Orchestrator) 2. AI Assistant/LabAI (Scientist/Reasoning) 3. Experiments (Memory/Structure) 4. Models (Prediction Engine)
Key Principle: Everything flows through the Workflow Engine.

component.name: Workflow Engine
component.responsibility: Event-driven orchestration that decides what happens next

component.name: AI Assistant (LabAI)
component.responsibility: Domain-aware reasoning engine for decisions, suggestions, interpretations
component.critical_rule: LabAI does NOT execute actions directly. It recommends → Workflows execute.

tracks.item: Why are we analyzing this data?

component.name: Models
component.responsibility: Executable statistical instruments that learn, predict, and signal
component.critical_rule: Models do not decide meaning. They emit signals, not conclusions.

automation_loop.description: The Closed Loop (This is the breakthrough)
automation_loop.flow: DATA → EXPERIMENT → MODEL → SIGNAL → AI INTERPRETATION → WORKFLOW ACTION → (back to DATA)

value_proposition.one_liner: LabIQ Health turns raw health data into automated insights — without code, dashboards, or guesswork.

differentiation.unique_value:
No system unifies: - Scientific intent (experiments) - Continuous learning (models) - Cognitive reasoning (AI) - Deterministic execution (workflows)
LabIQ Health does exactly that.
differentiation.key_insight: Automation is not "fewer clicks." Automation is the system knowing what to do next without being told.

core_principle.statement: The AI Assistant is a controlled, explainable intelligence layer — not a chatbot, not a doctor, not a black box.

capabilities.capability: Exposes structured reasoning, not raw thoughts

user_interaction_model.description: What users can prompt the AI to do

user_interaction_model.key_principle: This is intent-based AI, not free-form guessing.

mode.name: ANALYST
mode.purpose: Answer: "What is happening in the data?"

example_output.narrative: "Average resting heart rate increased steadily over the last 14 days, coinciding with reduced sleep duration."

mode.name: ML
mode.purpose: Answer: "What did the model do, and why?"

example_output.narrative: "The anomaly detection model flagged 12 abnormal periods, primarily driven by HRV and activity drop."

mode.name: LEARN
mode.purpose: Answer: "What does this mean in real-world health terms?"

example_output.narrative: "Heart Rate Variability (HRV) reflects autonomic nervous system balance. Lower HRV can be associated with stress or fatigue, but it is not a diagnostic indicator."
